tasks.symptom: Models configured with a generated common alias and separate input and output aliases no longer honor the independent names: validation can request the output name, and serialized output can fall back to the common name. Restore the input/output round trip while preserving explicit high-priority aliases and the fallback when only a common generator is configured.
tasks.impact_question: Trace generated names from configuration through field metadata into validation and serialization. Which precedence rules must remain intact for explicit aliases, separate generated aliases, and a common fallback?

mutations.old: return alias, validation_alias, serialization_alias  # type: ignore
mutations.mutant: return alias, serialization_alias, validation_alias  # type: ignore

tasks.symptom: Constructing a model from trusted values loses earlier field values when computing a later field default, although normal validation can compute it. Explicitly resolving a field default with a supplied mapping also loses that mapping. Restore data-dependent defaults across both entry points, including chained defaults and aliased input; keep zero-argument factories and static defaults working.
tasks.impact_question: Follow trusted model construction through field-default resolution to the factory call. Which values must each later factory see, how should aliases and explicit values affect that mapping, and when must a factory remain uncalled?
